definitions.gloss: lightning flash; the visible light of a lightning bolt
definitions.explanation: The bright flash of light produced by a lightning discharge. Distinguished from {雷|かみなり} (thunder, or lightning as a phenomenon) by focusing specifically on the visual flash of light.

examples.japanese: {雷光|らいこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: A flash of lightning ran across the sky.

examples.japanese: {雷光|らいこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{雷鳴|らいめい}→雷鳴：06188_raimei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: After the lightning flash, a loud thunderclap echoed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧、{雷光|らいこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{照|て}らした→照らす：04669_terasu⟧。
examples.english: At midnight, a lightning flash lit up the room as bright as day for an instant.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧: thunder; lightning (general term for the phenomenon)
- ⟦{稲妻|いなずま}→稲妻：04989_inazuma⟧: lightning bolt — the specific bolt or flash, often used in literary or dramatic contexts
- {雷光|らいこう}: lightning flash — emphasizes the visual light; more formal/literary
- ⟦{雷鳴|らいめい}→雷鳴：06188_raimei⟧: thunderclap — the sound (contrast with 雷光, the light)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雷光|らいこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: lightning flashes
- {雷光|らいこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: lightning streaks across the sky
- {雷光|らいこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{雷鳴|らいめい}→雷鳴：06188_raimei⟧: lightning and thunder
